mapper.select: select b.id, b.patrol_location_name, b.area_id from patrol_route a inner join patrol_location b on a.patrol_location_id = b.id where a.uuid = #{uuid} ORDER BY a.`rule_order`
mapper.sql:
select a.uuid as `id`, a.patrol_route_name, a.create_by, a.creator_id, a.creator_type, a.create_time, count(1) as `patrolLocationNumber` from patrol_route a
a.status = 'NO_REMOVE'
and a.patrol_route_name like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
GROUP BY a.uuid ORDER BY a.create_time desc
